_about: THE PRESETS OF THE PROCESSED RETURN (PLAN 10.8 · 10.9; DEC-21 · 21b · 22 · 23; RUNNING_LOG §116 · §125) — the transformations a return brick may give its sample: ONE effect of the engine's chain under an envelope. A return's variant is  <key>-<envelope>  and its sample is  <sample>~<key>-<envelope>  (bfl-impulse-1~crush4-perc), rendered by the engine right after the sample's capture. Read by the composer page (electronics/score/le_objects.js, opts.presetsUrl) and by tools/deal_variants.js · tools/build_audition.js. `args` are the chain's own control names (electronics/sc/process.scd), whole — nothing is merged in; a value may be a RANGE [lo, hi], drawn fresh each time the plan is sent — SINCE §125 EVERY PITCHED DIAL IS ONE (DEC-23, his word 'a': no two returns ring the same notes; the notes are luck within his ranges). THIRTY presets (his word §125): the shelf's (`from` = the shelf's row; `changed` says where a return's version differs), the AI's across the catalogue, and SEVEN versions of his own freeze `icy` — none of the stretches shifts pitch (his word). The spectral `freeze` and the `cloud` are out of the deal (still in the catalogue). Rows are PROVISIONAL until his ear.

colour.what: the effect is in the attack: the variant is as long as the impulse itself

time.what: the effect needs room: one and three quarters of the impulse

perc.what: 3 ms up, the rest down (Env.perc): keeps the attack

expodec.what: instant, then an exponential fall: keeps the attack

gauss.what: a bell: the attack is gone, a swell

tri.what: a triangle: up to the middle, then down

tail.what: the ring version — no envelope: it rings out to −60 dB under its peak, or is cut and faded at a RING TIME drawn fresh at every plan send, between 950 and 1350 ms past the source (his word 2026-10-05, RUNNING_LOG §118). A [lo, hi] here is drawn like a dial's range
